title: Professional Services Project Commitment and TimeBank Extension Fees
content:
**Extension project schedule.** On a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours extension, a client holding at least one time-and-materials Professional Services Projects engagement in progress, whatever other engagements it also holds, and with project time logged to the prepaid-block route in the month counted back from signing, has the fee multiplied by 0.9; a client holding at least one time-and-materials engagement in progress and with no such time in that month, by 0.95; any other client, by 1. The engagements and the logged time are those on the client's Professional Services Projects records: the engagement's pricing and status, and the work log lines whose settlement is the prepaid-block route.

| Time-and-materials engagement in progress | Time logged to the prepaid-block route in the month | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| at least one | yes | 0.9 |
| at least one | no | 0.95 |
| none (only fixed-fee engagements, or engagements not in progress) | any | 1 |

Hypothetical case: a fee of 500.00 before this multiplier becomes 450.00 or 475.00 respectively.
